items.title: AI Product Delivery Lead
items.category: 航空機・主要サプライヤー／AI
items.excerpt: Spirit Commercial, now a Boeing subsidiary, posted an AI Product Delivery Lead role in Wichita. The role owns AI initiatives from scoping and prioritization through production launch and post-launch evaluation; the business designs and builds fuselages, pylons, nacelles and wing components.

items.title: Siemens and Redington collaborate to accelerate digital transformation across Africa
items.excerpt: Redington became a distributor for Siemens Digital Industries Software across six African markets. The agreement gives aerospace and other industries local access to Teamcenter, Designcenter and Simcenter, with Siemens highlighting Industrial AI and Digital Twin capabilities across the Xcelerator portfolio.

items.title: UK Aerospace & Defence Conference
items.category: CAD・CAE／航空宇宙デジタルエンジニアリング
items.excerpt: Ansys' September 23 aerospace and defence conference centers on Certification by Analysis, MBSE/digital thread, and digital twins across test and evaluation. The agenda explicitly links validated computational analysis to airworthiness compliance, requirements traceability and reduced reliance on physical testing.
items.query: site:ansys.com September 2026 aerospace digital engineering MBSE certification simulation Ansys

items.title: Australian Missile Corporation Deploys Dassault Systèmes’ Applications to Support GWEO Delivery
items.excerpt: Australian Missile Corporation selected CATIA and SOLIDWORKS on 3DEXPERIENCE for mission, requirements and systems engineering. The secure on-premise environment is intended to support model-based engineering from requirements through systems design and validation, with lifecycle traceability and data control.

items.title: Hexagon releases next-generation OPTIV S 4.4.3 Optical CMM at IMTS
items.excerpt: Hexagon launched the next-generation OPTIV S optical CMM with about 30% higher machine dynamics and first application tests showing about 15% shorter inspection cycles. PC-DMIS will add phased AI-assisted measurement features through 2026-27; Hexagon lists aerospace among target industries.
items.query: site:hexagon.com September 2026 aerospace metrology manufacturing AI simulation Hexagon

items.title: Hexagon completes acquisition of ZG Technology
items.excerpt: Hexagon acquired the remaining 49% of ZG Technology, taking full ownership of the Wuhan portable 3D-scanning specialist. ZG scanners serve quality inspection, reverse engineering and complex-part digitization including aerospace; Hexagon plans unified handheld-scanning R&D and a Wuhan center of excellence.

items.title: Altair SimSolid 2026 Brings Meshless Electromagnetic Simulation to Electronics Engineers
items.excerpt: SimTool reports that SimSolid 2026 adds electromagnetic analysis directly on native CAD geometry without meshing, including S-parameter and modal EM studies. The release extends SimSolid's meshless workflow beyond structural and thermal analysis; SimSolid is now part of Siemens' Simcenter portfolio.

items.title: Faster Turbomachinery Design
items.excerpt: Simuneer announced a September 24 CadenceTECHTALK on a connected turbomachinery workflow linking CAD preparation, hybrid meshing, CFD, post-processing and design optimization. The session is led by a Cadence product engineering manager and targets repeatable automation and larger design-space exploration.

items.title: Eco Wave Power Signs Agreement with AI engineering GmbH to Advance AI-Powered Digital Twin Platform for Wave Energy
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: AI engineering GmbH will use its PAMICS particle-based multiphysics framework with operational data and ML to build a physics/data-driven digital twin. Its focus on GPU CFD, fluid-structure interaction and engineering optimization makes it a strong recurring CAE/scientific-AI watch candidate.
items.query: "AI engineering GmbH" September 2026 digital twin PAMICS

items.title: Rescale Expands Cloud Ecosystem with CoreWeave for Engineering and AI Workloads
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: Rescale expanded its digital-engineering cloud to CoreWeave for AI and simulation workloads across aerospace, automotive, energy and manufacturing. The platform combines compute, simulation software and AI, and the announcement explicitly cites AI physics and agentic-engineering workloads.

items.title: Digital Twin Industry Challenge Led Accelerator
items.excerpt: Discovery candidate: Digital Catapult opened a nine-month accelerator linking up to 12 UK SMEs with challenge owners in maritime, aerospace and defence to develop digital-twin solutions, with up to £75,000 Innovate UK grant support. It is a useful recurring source for emerging industrial digital-twin suppliers.
